exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-21T12:00:00Z
exec card init --board-name 'Primary board'
cmp .cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/template.yaml

# The default view names the selected namespace and reports every effective
# value with its supplying layer.
exec card --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/default.json
exec card config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/default.txt

# A scoped read exposes only values explicitly stored at that layer.
exec card --json config show --scope store
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/empty-store.json

# Store, project, and board mutations use the same selected board context.
exec card --json config set --scope store issue.id.prefix config-
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/store-prefix.json
exec card --json config set --scope project issue.summary.max_bytes 4096
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/project-summary.json
exec card --json config set --scope board attachment.max_bytes 1048576
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/board-attachment.json
exec card --json config set --scope board issue.id.strategy sequential
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/layered.json

exec card --json config show --scope project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/project-layer.json

# One field resolves through every mutable layer, and ID allocation consumes
# the live effective value at each operation boundary.
exec card --json config set --scope project issue.id.prefix project-
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/project-prefix.json
exec card --json config set --scope board issue.id.prefix board-
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/board-prefix.json
exec card create 'Board prefix'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/board-id.txt
exec card --json config unset --scope board issue.id.prefix
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/project-prefix.json
exec card create 'Project prefix'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/project-id.txt
exec card --json config unset --scope project issue.id.prefix
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/layered.json
exec card create 'Store prefix'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/store-id.txt

# Database-layer limits govern the same issue and attachment operations as
# store YAML limits.
exec card config set --scope board issue.summary.max_bytes 4
! exec card create --summary 12345 'Oversized summary'
! stdout .
stderr 'summary is 5 bytes; maximum is 4 bytes'
exec card config unset --scope board issue.summary.max_bytes
exec card config set --scope board attachment.max_bytes 4
! exec card attachment add six-bytes.txt
! stdout .
stderr 'attachment expected size 6 exceeds 4 bytes'

# Clearing an override returns the effective inherited view. Clearing the final
# store override removes the optional YAML without breaking later reads.
exec card --json config unset --scope board attachment.max_bytes
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/without-board-attachment.json
exec card --json config unset --scope project issue.summary.max_bytes
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/without-project-summary.json
exec card --json config unset --scope store issue.id.prefix
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/default-with-board-strategy.json
! exists .cardamom/config.yaml
exec card --json config show --scope store
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/empty-store.json
exec card create 'Built-in prefix'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/built-in-id.txt

# Mutation scope, finite keys, and typed values are validated before writes.
! exec card config set issue.id.prefix missing-scope-
stderr '--scope'
! exec card config set --scope board unsupported.key value
stderr 'unsupported.key'
! exec card config set --scope board issue.id.prefix Invalid-
stderr 'must contain lowercase letters'
! exec card config set --scope board issue.id.strategy uuid
stderr 'invalid issue ID strategy "uuid"'
! exec card config set --scope board issue.summary.max_bytes 2MB
stderr 'byte limit "2MB"'
! exec card config set --scope board attachment.max_bytes 0
stderr 'must be between 1 and'

exec card --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/default-with-board-strategy.json

# Help presents the read and mutation boundaries and the finite key vocabulary.
exec card config --help
stdout 'Inspect and update typed configuration'
stdout 'config show'
stdout 'config set'
stdout 'config unset'
exec card config show --help
stdout 'effective configuration by default'
stdout 'raw store, project, or board layer'
exec card config set --help
stdout 'Layer to update: store, project, or board'
stdout 'positive decimal byte count'
stdout 'issue.id.prefix'
stdout 'attachment.max_bytes'
exec card config unset --help
stdout 'Layer to update: store, project, or board'
stdout 'inherits from less specific layers'
stdout 'issue.id.prefix'
stdout 'attachment.max_bytes'

-- six-bytes.txt --
12345
-- golden/template.yaml --
# config.yaml contains local overrides for this physical Cardamom store.
# Missing or commented values inherit built-in, project, or board values.
# Use card config set --scope store KEY VALUE to set one value.
# Use card config unset --scope store KEY to restore inheritance.
#
# Built-in defaults are shown below.
# version: 1
# issue:
#   id:
#     prefix: cm-
#     strategy: random
#   summary:
#     max_bytes: 2048
# attachment:
#   max_bytes: 104857600
-- golden/default.json --
{"scope":"effective","store":"$WORK/.cardamom","project":"project_00000000000000000000","board":"board_00000000000000000000","values":{"issue":{"id":{"prefix":"cm-","strategy":"random"},"summary":{"max_bytes":2048}},"attachment":{"max_bytes":104857600}},"origins":{"issue":{"id":{"prefix":{"scope":"built_in","identity":"built-in"},"strategy":{"scope":"built_in","identity":"built-in"}},"summary":{"max_bytes":{"scope":"built_in","identity":"built-in"}}},"attachment":{"max_bytes":{"scope":"built_in","identity":"built-in"}}}}
-- golden/default.txt --
Scope:    effective
Store:    $WORK/.cardamom
Project:  project_00000000000000000000
Board:    board_00000000000000000000

KEY                      VALUE      ORIGIN
issue.id.prefix          cm-        built_in (built-in)
issue.id.strategy        random     built_in (built-in)
issue.summary.max_bytes  2048       built_in (built-in)
attachment.max_bytes     104857600  built_in (built-in)
